notes.title: v1.10: Day night cycle
notes.notes:
[img]http://media.indiedb.com/cache/images/games/1/44/43316/thumb_620x2000/night.jpg[/img]
[img]http://media.indiedb.com/cache/images/games/1/44/43316/thumb_620x2000/night2.jpg[/img]

[b]Feature[/b]
Day Night Cycle:
Now there is day night cycle system, player can config it on the map selection menu.

Free building placement:
Except the resource center, other base buildings can be placed freely on the map.

Improved ground vehicle destroyed effect:
When the ground vehicles are destroyed, this camouflage will change into rust color, and the heavy vehicles may have a chance to burn for a while before explosion.

[b]New Building[/b]
Firebase:
The dozer can build the firebase which can garrison at most 4 infantries, and it can call the helicopter to carry a missile turret or even howitzer on it.

notes.title: Update 1.03: Panhard, faster game pace and new icons

[img]http://media.indiedb.com/cache/images/games/1/44/43316/thumb_620x2000/capsule.png[/img]

More help text and icons on building platform, mercenary camps and flag points.

notes.title: Hotfix Version 1.01
notes.notes:
After receiving feedbacks from players, I made a hotfix version.

Fix:
1. Improve the ground vehicle pathfinding.
2. Fix some bugs that infantry can not garrison into some neutral buildings.
3. Debuff  the gurad tower, -25% damage, -20% attack range, -20% F-35 airsupport damage.
4. Increase the damage of Su-25 Strike from 350 to 400.

Thanks to all players, making RTS games is much harder than I expected, but I will keep polishing the game:)

[img]http://media.indiedb.com/cache/images/games/1/44/43316/thumb_620x2000/ArmorClash_2016-06-19_19-06-19-38.png[/img]

notes.title: 1 man + 1 year + Unity = my first RTS game: Armor Clash
notes.notes:
By using the Unity 5 game engine and its asset store. I made my first RTS game: Armor Clash, within 1 year. Now its beta version is available on Steam.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Obbg4GbSlFw

20 years ago, at the great age of RTS game, I was still in school and dreamed of making my own RTS game one day. The dream is sweet, but when I really decide to do it, I feel it is impossible. Like many others indie developers, I can do some coding work but lack in art skill. Forming a team need influence and funds, which I am also in short of.

It is in 2013 I know Unity first time from a forum, at first I did not care much because I thought it is just a SDK like many other programming tools, till I found there is the asset store, I can get model and sound assets at a reasonable price, even I can find solutions like dynamic water, mini radar and vehicle system. I realized that if I bought all the works I can not do, I can make the game just by my self.

Then I began to learn Unity by sparing time. and after made a small demo I had enough confidence and resigned my job. Although there are plenty of art assets available, it still cost me much time on modifying to meet my needs, new ideas came out before implementing old ones, the developing work is still not easy.

After 14 month's work, it is now 90% finished and goes into beta phase. I will keep updating this game with new ideas and the latest technology of Unity engine.


Windforce
2015-12-23

notes.title: Hotkey tips.
notes.notes:
[img]http://media.indiedb.com/cache/images/games/1/44/43316/thumb_620x2000/auto_get_in.png[/img]

[list]
[*][b]F + left click:[/b] Attack move to target point, units will automatically engaging.
[*][b]R:[/b] Stop moving.
[*][b]C:[/b] Reverse back, vehicle will reverse back for a short distance without turning, an useful micro to protect low hp units.
[*][b]Z:[/b] When selecting infantries, they will automatically enter APCs nearby, no need to deliver them one by one. When selecting APC, they will order infantries nearby to board the vehicle.
[*][b]G:[/b] When selecting infantries, they will automatically garrison into buildings nearby, no need to deliver them one by one.
[*][b]X:[/b] Let the infantry move out from vehicles or buildings.
[/list]

[*]Resource center, barracks, factory building time reduced from 40 sec to 25 sec, Power plant, Command center building time reduced from 40 sec to 30 sec.
[*]Cannon attack range of main battle tank reduced from 65 to 60.
[*]Unit normal sight range reduced from 135 to 100.
[*]The guard range of mercenaries reduced from 90 to 80.
[/olist]

[b]Bug Fix:[/b]
[olist]
[*]Fix infantry can move when playing dead animation.
[*]Fix infantry attack type from cannon to machinegun.
[/olist]
